Screenshot of an Instagram story (handle arman_4gs, posted 3h earlier) showing a newspaper clipping titled "And In 1933...", submitted by a reader to an "Our Town" column, beside a black-and-white photograph of Adolf Hitler in uniform with a swastika armband. The clipping claims Hitler appointed Hermann Goring Minister of the Interior in 1933 and ordered police departments defunded and eliminated so his Brown Shirts could riot and intimidate voters; several phrases are underlined in pink marker. The claim is a widely circulated distortion — the Nazi regime expanded and politicized police forces rather than defunding them.
text: arman_4gs 3h. And In 1933... Submitted by a Faithful Our Town Reader. In 1933 Hitler appointed Hermann Goring Minister of the Interior. His first orders were to defund and eliminate police departments so that they would not interfere with his Brown Shirts whose mission it was to riot, burn, beat up and kill citizens in an effort to sway the elections.
flags: Historical claim is misleading/debunked: Goring was Prussian Interior Minister and expanded police powers; the Nazis did not defund police

description: Two-panel meme collage. Right: the same Instagram-story screenshot of an "And In 1933..." newspaper clipping (handle arman_4gs) claiming Hitler had Hermann Goring defund and eliminate police so the Brown Shirts could riot and sway elections, beside a photo of Hitler with a swastika armband. The juxtaposition implies a parallel between Obama and Nazi Germany.
